items.question: Trong câu "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change words into another language
items.explanation: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi thành. "Translate A into B" ở đây = chuyển yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thành task kỹ thuật, không phải dịch tiếng.
items.explanationEn: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (verb): to turn into another form. "Translate A into B" here means turning business needs into technical tasks, not changing languages.

items.question: Trong câu "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put into effect, to build
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (động từ): hiện thực hóa, triển khai. "Implement a feature" = hiện thực hóa tính năng bằng code; danh từ: implementation.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (verb): to put into effect, to build. "Implement a feature" means building it in code; noun: implementation.

items.question: Trong câu "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", từ "skill" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One of the most important skills of a BA is to translate business requirements into technical tasks that are clear enough for developers to estimate and implement.", what does "skill" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an ability to do something well
items.explanation: skill /skɪl/ (danh từ): kỹ năng. "Soft skills" = kỹ năng mềm; tính từ: skilled/skillful (lành nghề).
items.explanationEn: skill /skɪl/ (noun): an ability to do something well. "Soft skills" are people skills; adjectives: skilled, skillful.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", từ "whether" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", what does "whether" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whether /ˈweðə/ (liên từ): liệu... hay không. "Whether A or B" = liệu A hay B; đừng nhầm với weather (thời tiết).
items.explanationEn: whether /ˈweðə/ (conjunction): if, used for two choices. "Whether A or B" presents two options; do not confuse with weather.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", từ "existing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", what does "existing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (tính từ): hiện có, sẵn có. "An existing API" = API đã có sẵn; động từ: exist (tồn tại).
items.explanationEn: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (adjective): already present or in use. "An existing API" is one that is already there; verb: exist.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether a new API is needed or an existing API can be reused", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): tái sử dụng. "Reuse code" = tái sử dụng code; tính từ: reusable (có thể tái sử dụng).
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Reuse code" means using it again; adjective: reusable.

items.question: Trong câu "Which tasks depend on which (dependency)", từ "depend on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which tasks depend on which (dependency)", what does "depend on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (cụm từ): phụ thuộc vào. "A depends on B" = A phụ thuộc B; danh từ: dependency (sự phụ thuộc).
items.explanationEn: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (phrase): to need something else first. "A depends on B" means A needs B; noun: dependency.

items.question: Trong câu "What needs to be agreed upon first (API contract)", từ "agree upon" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What needs to be agreed upon first (API contract)", what does "agree upon" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to reach a shared decision on
items.explanation: agree upon /əˈɡriː əˌpɒn/ (cụm từ): thống nhất, thỏa thuận. "Agree on/upon something" = thống nhất về điều gì; danh từ: agreement.
items.explanationEn: agree upon /əˈɡriː əˌpɒn/ (phrase): to reach a shared decision on. "Agree on/upon something" means deciding it together; noun: agreement.

items.question: Trong câu "Without this mindset, tasks become vague, developers estimate incorrectly, and the sprint slips.", từ "mindset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without this mindset, tasks become vague, developers estimate incorrectly, and the sprint slips.", what does "mindset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mindset /ˈmaɪndset/ (danh từ): tư duy, lối suy nghĩ. "A growth mindset" = tư duy phát triển; "BA mindset" = cách nghĩ của BA.
items.explanationEn: mindset /ˈmaɪndset/ (noun): a way of thinking. "A growth mindset" is a way of thinking that welcomes learning.

items.question: Trong câu "Without this mindset, tasks become vague, developers estimate incorrectly, and the sprint slips.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without this mindset, tasks become vague, developers estimate incorrectly, and the sprint slips.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to lose your footing and fall
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ tiến độ. "The sprint slips" = sprint bị trễ; "the deadline slipped" = hạn chót bị lùi.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind schedule. "The sprint slips" means it runs late; "the deadline slipped" means it moved later.

items.question: Trong câu "UI Components: rendering the interface, layout, responsive design", từ "render" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UI Components: rendering the interface, layout, responsive design", what does "render" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: render /ˈrendə/ (động từ): hiển thị (giao diện). "Render the UI" = vẽ, hiển thị giao diện; danh từ: rendering.
items.explanationEn: render /ˈrendə/ (verb): to draw on the screen. "Render the UI" means drawing it on screen; noun: rendering.

items.question: Trong câu "UI Components: rendering the interface, layout, responsive design", từ "responsive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UI Components: rendering the interface, layout, responsive design", what does "responsive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: responsive /rɪˈspɒnsɪv/ (tính từ): tương thích mọi màn hình. "Responsive design" = thiết kế tự co giãn theo kích thước màn hình.
items.explanationEn: responsive /rɪˈspɒnsɪv/ (adjective): adapting to any screen size. "Responsive design" adjusts the layout to the screen size.

items.question: Trong câu "Local storage: temporarily storing the token, user preferences", từ "temporarily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Local storage: temporarily storing the token, user preferences", what does "temporarily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: temporarily /ˈtemprərəli/ (trạng từ): tạm thời. "Temporarily store" = lưu tạm; tính từ: temporary; trái nghĩa: permanently.
items.explanationEn: temporarily /ˈtemprərəli/ (adverb): for a short time only. "Temporarily store" means keep for a while; adjective: temporary; opposite: permanently.

items.question: Trong câu "Local storage: temporarily storing the token, user preferences", từ "preference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Local storage: temporarily storing the token, user preferences", what does "preference" (noun) mean?
options: tùy chọn, sở thích cá nhân
items.explanation: preference /ˈprefrəns/ (danh từ): tùy chọn, sở thích cá nhân. "User preferences" = các tùy chọn của người dùng như ngôn ngữ, giao diện tối.
items.explanationEn: preference /ˈprefrəns/ (noun): a setting a person likes. "User preferences" are settings such as language or dark mode; verb: prefer.

items.question: Trong câu "API calls: calling BE APIs to fetch/send data", từ "fetch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "API calls: calling BE APIs to fetch/send data", what does "fetch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fetch /fetʃ/ (động từ): lấy về, tải về. "Fetch data" = lấy dữ liệu từ server; nghĩa gốc: đi lấy mang về.
items.explanationEn: fetch /fetʃ/ (verb): to get and bring back. "Fetch data" means getting it from a server; originally, to go and bring back.

items.question: Trong câu "Form handling: client-side input validation, form submission", từ "submission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Form handling: client-side input validation, form submission", what does "submission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: submission /səbˈmɪʃn/ (danh từ): việc gửi đi (biểu mẫu). "Form submission" = gửi form; động từ: submit (gửi, nộp).
items.explanationEn: submission /səbˈmɪʃn/ (noun): the act of sending in. "Form submission" is sending a form; verb: submit.

items.question: Trong câu "API endpoints: creating and maintaining REST/GraphQL APIs", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "API endpoints: creating and maintaining REST/GraphQL APIs", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): bảo trì, duy trì. "Maintain an API" = bảo trì API; danh từ: maintenance (sự bảo trì).
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep working properly. "Maintain an API" means keeping it working; noun: maintenance.

items.question: Trong câu "Validation: re-validating all incoming data (never trust FE)", từ "incoming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validation: re-validating all incoming data (never trust FE)", what does "incoming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incoming /ˈɪnkʌmɪŋ/ (tính từ): gửi đến, đi vào. "Incoming data" = dữ liệu gửi đến; trái nghĩa: outgoing.
items.explanationEn: incoming /ˈɪnkʌmɪŋ/ (adjective): arriving from outside. "Incoming data" is data arriving at the server; opposite: outgoing.

items.question: Trong câu "External services: email, SMS, payment, storage", từ "external" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "External services: email, SMS, payment, storage", what does "external" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: external /ɪkˈstɜːnl/ (tính từ): bên ngoài. "External services" = dịch vụ bên ngoài; trái nghĩa: internal.
items.explanationEn: external /ɪkˈstɜːnl/ (adjective): from outside the system. "External services" come from outside; opposite: internal.

items.question: Trong câu "Cron jobs: background tasks that run on a schedule", từ "schedule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cron jobs: background tasks that run on a schedule", what does "schedule" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: schedule /ˈʃedjuːl/ (danh từ): lịch trình định sẵn. "On a schedule" = theo lịch định sẵn; "ahead of schedule" = sớm hơn kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: schedule /ˈʃedjuːl/ (noun): a plan of fixed times. "On a schedule" means at planned times; "ahead of schedule" means early.

items.question: Trong câu "File processing: handling uploads, conversion", từ "conversion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "File processing: handling uploads, conversion", what does "conversion" (noun) mean?

items.explanation: conversion /kənˈvɜːʃn/ (danh từ): sự chuyển đổi (định dạng). "File conversion" = chuyển đổi định dạng file; động từ: convert.
items.explanationEn: conversion /kənˈvɜːʃn/ (noun): changing into another format. "File conversion" changes a file's format; verb: convert.

items.question: Trong câu "From the user story, list all screens and components:", từ "list" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: list /lɪst/ (verb): to write down one by one. Here "list" is a verb meaning to name items one by one; as a noun it is a set of items.

items.question: Trong câu "From the user story, list all screens and components:", từ "component" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "From the user story, list all screens and components:", what does "component" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: component /kəmˈpəʊnənt/ (danh từ): thành phần. "UI component" = thành phần giao diện như nút, bảng, form.
items.explanationEn: component /kəmˈpəʊnənt/ (noun): a part of a whole. A "UI component" is a building block such as a button or table.

items.question: Trong câu "Each FE action needs an API endpoint:", từ "action" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each FE action needs an API endpoint:", what does "action" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: action /ˈækʃn/ (danh từ): thao tác, hành động. "User action" = thao tác của người dùng như bấm nút, gửi form.
items.explanationEn: action /ˈækʃn/ (noun): something a user does. A "user action" is something like clicking or submitting.

items.question: Trong câu "Each FE action needs an API endpoint:", từ "endpoint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each FE action needs an API endpoint:", what does "endpoint" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the end of a line or route
a URL where an API is called
items.explanation: endpoint /ˈendpɔɪnt/ (danh từ): địa chỉ gọi API. "API endpoint" = một địa chỉ URL + method mà client gọi tới.
items.explanationEn: endpoint /ˈendpɔɪnt/ (noun): a URL where an API is called. An "API endpoint" is a URL plus method that a client calls.

items.question: Trong câu "Agree on the format before coding:", từ "agree on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agree on the format before coding:", what does "agree on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: agree on /əˈɡriː ɒn/ (cụm từ): thống nhất về. "Agree on the format" = thống nhất định dạng trước khi code.
items.explanationEn: agree on /əˈɡriː ɒn/ (phrase): to decide together on. "Agree on the format" means deciding it together before coding.

items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈdentɪfaɪ/ (verb): to find and name. "Identify the screens" means finding and naming them; noun: identification.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2: Identify the required APIs (BE)", từ "required" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: required /rɪˈkwaɪəd/ (adjective): needed, necessary. A "required field" must be filled; opposite: optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 3: Define the API Contract", từ "define" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: define /dɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to state exactly. "Define the contract" means stating it exactly; noun: definition.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 4: Break it down into concrete tasks", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 4: Break it down into concrete tasks", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /ˌbreɪk ˈdaʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ. "Break down a feature" = chia nhỏ tính năng; danh từ: breakdown.
items.explanationEn: break down /ˌbreɪk ˈdaʊn/ (phrase): to divide into smaller parts. "Break down a feature" means splitting it; noun: breakdown.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 4: Break it down into concrete tasks", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 4: Break it down into concrete tasks", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Concrete tasks" = task cụ thể, làm được ngay; trái nghĩa: abstract.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (adjective): specific and clear. "Concrete tasks" are specific and actionable; opposite: abstract.

items.question: Trong câu "API Contract is the agreement between FE and BE about:", từ "agreement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: agreement /əˈɡriːmənt/ (danh từ): sự thỏa thuận. "Reach an agreement" = đạt được thỏa thuận; động từ: agree.
items.explanationEn: agreement /əˈɡriːmənt/ (noun): a shared decision. "Reach an agreement" means come to a shared decision; verb: agree.

items.question: Trong câu "FE and BE can work in parallel if the contract is clear.", từ "in parallel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈpærəlel/ (cụm từ): song song, cùng lúc. "Work in parallel" = làm song song; trái nghĩa: in sequence (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈpærəlel/ (phrase): at the same time. "Work in parallel" means at the same time; opposite: in sequence.

items.question: Trong câu "FE and BE can work in parallel if the contract is clear.", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (noun): a technical agreement on format. An "API contract" is a technical agreement on requests and responses, not a legal paper.

items.question: Trong câu "FE uses mock data while BE builds the real API.", từ "mock" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: mock /mɒk/ (adjective): fake, for testing. "Mock data" is fake data for testing; the verb "mock" also means to make fun of.

items.explanationEn: wire /ˈwaɪə/ (verb): to connect to work together. "Wire FE and BE together" means connecting them; literally, fitting cables.

items.explanationEn: classification /ˌklæsɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): sorting into groups. "Quick classification" means sorting quickly; verb: classify.

items.explanationEn: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (phrase): to be part of. "A belongs to B" means A is part of B; noun: belongings.

items.explanationEn: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (verb): to show. "Display a list" means showing it; as a noun, a display is a screen.

items.question: Trong câu "Calculate price, tax, discount", từ "calculate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Calculate price, tax, discount", what does "calculate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: calculate /ˈkælkjuleɪt/ (động từ): tính toán. "Calculate the price" = tính giá; danh từ: calculation.
items.explanationEn: calculate /ˈkælkjuleɪt/ (verb): to work out with numbers. "Calculate the price" means working it out; noun: calculation.

items.question: Trong câu "Calculate price, tax, discount", từ "discount" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Calculate price, tax, discount", what does "discount" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: discount /ˈdɪskaʊnt/ (danh từ): khoản giảm giá. "Apply a discount" = áp dụng giảm giá; động từ discount còn nghĩa xem nhẹ.
items.explanationEn: discount /ˈdɪskaʊnt/ (noun): a reduction in price. "Apply a discount" means reducing the price; the verb can also mean to disregard.

items.question: Trong câu ""Does this API already exist or do we need to create a new one?" → affects the estimate", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Does this API already exist or do we need to create a new one?" → affects the estimate", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng đến. "Affects the estimate" = ảnh hưởng tới ước lượng; danh từ liên quan: effect.
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Affects the estimate" means it changes the estimate; related noun: effect.

items.question: Trong câu ""Does this API already exist or do we need to create a new one?" → affects the estimate", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Does this API already exist or do we need to create a new one?" → affects the estimate", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (danh từ): con số ước lượng. Danh từ "estimate" đọc /-mət/, động từ đọc /-meɪt/.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (noun): a rough calculation. The noun ends in /-mət/; the verb ends in /-meɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu ""Is there a similar screen we've already built?" → might be reusable", từ "similar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Is there a similar screen we've already built?" → might be reusable", what does "similar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: similar /ˈsɪmələ/ (tính từ): tương tự. "Similar to" = tương tự với; danh từ: similarity.
items.explanationEn: similar /ˈsɪmələ/ (adjective): almost the same. "Similar to" means almost the same as; noun: similarity.

items.question: Trong câu ""Is there a similar screen we've already built?" → might be reusable", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Is there a similar screen we've already built?" → might be reusable", what does "reusable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reusable /ˌriːˈjuːzəbl/ (tính từ): có thể tái sử dụng. "Reusable component" = thành phần tái sử dụng được; trái nghĩa: disposable.
items.explanationEn: reusable /ˌriːˈjuːzəbl/ (adjective): able to be used again. A "reusable component" can be used again; opposite: disposable.

items.question: Trong câu ""Do FE and BE need to work at the same time, or can they work in parallel?" → affects the sprint plan", từ "at the same time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Do FE and BE need to work at the same time, or can they work in parallel?" → affects the sprint plan", what does "at the same time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the same time /æt ðə seɪm taɪm/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At the same time" = cùng lúc; còn dùng như "tuy vậy" để nối ý.
items.explanationEn: at the same time /æt ðə seɪm taɪm/ (phrase): simultaneously. "At the same time" means simultaneously; it can also mean however.

items.question: Trong câu ""Is there any dependency that takes extra time?"", từ "extra" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Is there any dependency that takes extra time?"", what does "extra" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extra /ˈekstrə/ (tính từ): thêm, phụ trội. "Extra time" = thời gian phát sinh thêm; "extra cost" = chi phí thêm.
items.explanationEn: extra /ˈekstrə/ (adjective): more than usual. "Extra time" is additional time; "extra cost" is additional cost.

items.question: Trong câu ""Is there any dependency that takes extra time?"", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Is there any dependency that takes extra time?"", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a need for another task first
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc. "Task dependency" = task phụ thuộc task khác; động từ: depend on.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): a need for another task first. A "task dependency" means one task needs another first; verb: depend on.

items.question: Trong câu ""Do we need a third-party integration?" (payment, SMS, AI...)", từ "third-party" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Do we need a third-party integration?" (payment, SMS, AI...)", what does "third-party" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: third-party /ˌθɜːd ˈpɑːti/ (tính từ): của bên thứ ba. "Third-party integration" = tích hợp dịch vụ của công ty khác (Stripe, SMS...).
items.explanationEn: third-party /ˌθɜːd ˈpɑːti/ (adjective): from an outside company. A "third-party integration" connects a service from another company.

items.question: Trong câu ""Do we need a third-party integration?" (payment, SMS, AI...)", từ "integration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Do we need a third-party integration?" (payment, SMS, AI...)", what does "integration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: integration /ˌɪntɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự tích hợp. "Payment integration" = tích hợp thanh toán; động từ: integrate.
items.explanationEn: integration /ˌɪntɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (noun): connecting systems together. "Payment integration" connects a payment system; verb: integrate.

items.question: Trong câu ""Is there any breaking change that affects other features?"", từ "breaking change" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Is there any breaking change that affects other features?"", what does "breaking change" (phrase) mean?
options: thay đổi làm hỏng tương thích
optionsEn: a change that breaks old usage
items.explanation: breaking change /ˈbreɪkɪŋ tʃeɪndʒ/ (cụm từ): thay đổi làm hỏng tương thích. "Breaking change" = thay đổi khiến phần đang dùng bị lỗi nếu không cập nhật.
items.explanationEn: breaking change /ˈbreɪkɪŋ tʃeɪndʒ/ (phrase): a change that breaks old usage. A "breaking change" makes existing users fail unless they update.

items.question: Trong câu "The dependency chain determines the order of work:", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The dependency chain determines the order of work:", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (động từ): quyết định, xác định. "Determine the order" = quyết định thứ tự; tính từ: determined (quyết tâm).
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (verb): to decide or fix. "Determine the order" means fixing it; adjective: determined (resolved).

items.question: Trong câu "The dependency chain determines the order of work:", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The dependency chain determines the order of work:", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi nối tiếp. "Dependency chain" = chuỗi phụ thuộc, việc này nối tiếp việc kia.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a linked sequence. A "dependency chain" is a sequence where each step needs the one before.

items.question: Trong câu "FE/BE tasks that need to be wired together → allow buffer time for integration", từ "buffer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "FE/BE tasks that need to be wired together → allow buffer time for integration", what does "buffer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌfə/ (danh từ): thời gian dự phòng. "Buffer time" = thời gian dự phòng; trong máy tính "buffer" còn là bộ đệm.
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌfə/ (noun): spare time for surprises. "Buffer time" is spare time; in computing a buffer also stores data temporarily.

items.question: Trong câu "FE/BE tasks that need to be wired together → allow buffer time for integration", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "FE/BE tasks that need to be wired together → allow buffer time for integration", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): dành ra, tính trước. "Allow time for X" = dành sẵn thời gian cho X; nghĩa thường gặp: cho phép.
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to set aside. "Allow time for X" means set time aside; its usual sense is to permit.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", từ "technical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", what does "technical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (tính từ): thuộc kỹ thuật. "Technical ticket" = ticket mô tả công việc kỹ thuật cho developer.
items.explanationEn: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (adjective): about engineering work. A "technical ticket" describes engineering work for developers.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", từ "ticket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", what does "ticket" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pass for a show or trip
items.explanation: ticket /ˈtɪkɪt/ (danh từ): phiếu công việc. Trong phần mềm, "ticket" là một đầu việc trên Jira; "raise a ticket" = tạo ticket.
items.explanationEn: ticket /ˈtɪkɪt/ (noun): a tracked work item. In software a "ticket" is a tracked work item; "raise a ticket" means create one.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", từ "format" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", what does "format" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: format /ˈfɔːmæt/ (danh từ): định dạng, khuôn mẫu. "This format" = khuôn mẫu này; động từ format còn là định dạng lại ổ đĩa.
items.explanationEn: format /ˈfɔːmæt/ (noun): a set layout or structure. "This format" is this layout; the verb format can also mean to wipe a disk.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", từ "clearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA creates a technical ticket, this format helps developers understand clearly:", what does "clearly" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way easy to understand
items.explanation: clearly /ˈklɪəli/ (trạng từ): rõ ràng. "Understand clearly" = hiểu rõ; tính từ: clear.
items.explanationEn: clearly /ˈklɪəli/ (adverb): in a way easy to understand. "Understand clearly" means understand without confusion; adjective: clear.

items.question: Trong câu "Build the user management page for admins, showing the list and allowing search/filter.", từ "management" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Build the user management page for admins, showing the list and allowing search/filter.", what does "management" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: management /ˈmænɪdʒmənt/ (danh từ): sự quản lý. "User management" = quản lý người dùng; động từ: manage.
items.explanationEn: management /ˈmænɪdʒmənt/ (noun): controlling and organizing. "User management" means handling users; verb: manage.

items.question: Trong câu "Build the user management page for admins, showing the list and allowing search/filter.", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Build the user management page for admins, showing the list and allowing search/filter.", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): cho phép. "Allow search" = cho phép tìm kiếm; "allow somebody to do" = cho ai làm gì.
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to let something happen. "Allow search" means letting users search; "allow somebody to do" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "Layout per Figma: [Figma frame link]", từ "per" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Layout per Figma: [Figma frame link]", what does "per" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: per /pɜː/ (giới từ): theo, dựa theo. "Per Figma" = theo Figma; "20 items per page" = 20 mục mỗi trang.
items.explanationEn: per /pɜː/ (preposition): according to. "Per Figma" means according to Figma; "20 items per page" means for each page.

items.question: Trong câu "Error state when the API fails", từ "fail" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Error state when the API fails", what does "fail" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fail /feɪl/ (động từ): bị lỗi, thất bại. "The API fails" = API bị lỗi; danh từ: failure.
items.explanationEn: fail /feɪl/ (verb): to stop working. "The API fails" means it does not work; noun: failure.
